description: This file contains shell script functions for upgrading firmware and checking platform compatibility in an OpenWRT target environment. It defines functions to perform device checks, generate and compare partition layouts, execute firmware upgrades, and copy configuration backups.

methods.name: mbl_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout has changed between device images and prompts the user to abort or continue if differences are detected.

methods.name: mbl_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by comparing partition layouts, writing images to device partitions, and updating UUIDs.

methods.name: mbl_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the boot partition.
